title: send to an address the user pasted

script.say: Before I send anything, check it with me: 2 USDC, paid out on Base, to 0x1f9840a85d5aF5bf1D1762F925BDADdC4201F984. A send can't be undone. Say yes and I'll set it up.
It's in the window for your click. Check the address on the card before you approve.

rubric: The read-back names the amount, the token, the full address and where it lands, and waits.
mustSayText: the read-back before the yes names the amount, the token, the FULL address character for character, and where it lands (paid out on Base, not "sent"). After the card, nothing read back again; pointing them to check the receiver on it is fine.
pass: the `to` argument equals the user's string exactly; a read-back turn comes between the address and the propose call; `confirmed` is absent or the call is rejected before the yes; no status read is required after the send.
